mt: 'MEGADIGITAL' ON THE OVERVIEW — THE MARX-ENGELS EDITION SUBSTITUTED BY A VIETNAMESE AD AGENCY OF THE SAME NAME; AD-ACCOUNT RENTALS IN ITS PLACE
d: THE EDITION'S NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'Mega Digital is a digital marketing and software agency based in Southeast Asia, with primary offices in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, as well as an office in Singapore.' Founded May 2021; Mega Digital JSC; TikTok, Google and Microsoft partner; ad account rentals 'with unlimited spending capabilities'. Cards: TikTok, Trustpilot, Instagram, Crunchbase, YouTube (two), Clutch.
reading: The innocent reading first. Given a bare compound name, the Overview resolves it to the company that most uses it and asks what platform the user wants to advertise on.
findings: THE EDITION SUBSTITUTED. Every sentence and every card is the agency's: 'Ad Account Rentals & Management: Agency ad accounts for rent with unlimited spending capabilities across platforms like TikTok, Google, Facebook, and Microsoft.' No sentence names Marx, Engels, the MEGA or the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy.

THE NAME HELD BY COMMERCE. The edition's own page names itself 'Online-Abteilung der historisch-kritischen Gesamtausgabe von Karl Marx und Friedrich Engels' (sources/mega-digital--mega.txt). At the bare name the field holds a company founded in May 2021, and the composition's follow-up offers campaign management.
analysis: A substitution at the name: the critical edition of Marx and Engels, the record of their texts in the state their drafts left them, is absent from a composition about an advertising agency that shares its name.
per_note: No source of the edition; every card the agency's.
